column1: # Partition table for thumb-nas.
# The board carries 32MB of flash (GigaDevice c8:4019
# `esptool flash_id`). The stock partitions_singleapp.csv sizes its app
# partition from whatever CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE claims
# setting produced a 1MB app partition that WebDAV + TLS + auth had filled to
# 94%. This table sizes the app deliberately instead.
# No OTA partitions: this device is reflashed over USB by hand
# app bank would only cost space. Adding OTA later means resizing here.
# Layout (offsets are absolute; the table itself lives at 0x8000):
#   0x009000   24K  nvs        WiFi calibration + any future key/value data
#   0x00f000    4K  phy_init   RF calibration
#   0x010000    4M  factory    the application
#   0x410000  ~27M  (unallocated -- free for a future data partition; adding
#                    one here does not move anything above it)
# Bulk storage is the SD card
# defined. 4MB of app space is roughly 4x the current binary.
# Name
nvs
phy_init
factory
